name: Kappa throw
notes: Generic throw (C4), the 259 shove played on the Kappa. Clip 30 frames, palm reach window 6-12: 5/7/18, startup = C4's 5, damage 120, break window 7; recovery 18 outlasts the break window (E12). Same numbers as Kitsune's and Ryo's throws. Throwbox is Kitsune's (x 20, y 150, 110 x 120) reshaped for the Kappa: height x0.886 puts it at y 135, h 105; width x1.1 for his longer arms. The retarget gate measured his push landing at 0.91 m (182 units, inside y 135-240). Estimated, not re-placed from the posed rig: proposed. The clip carries a 28 cm hip advance that must be replaced by a data step (E15); throw.schema.json has no forward-travel field, so that step is NOT encoded (same open item as Kitsune's and Ryo's throws). Pushback left to fight defaults. Not River Grab: that is the Kappa's special (130 damage, 6/2/30, YOK-229). Same buttons in Kata and Kihon (K3).
